title: Keep more, risk the whole pie
hook: Two stated cases: explore the expected payoff rather than the retained share alone.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the expected payoff rather than the retained share alone affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Expected, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the expected payoff rather than the retained share alone in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy proposer divides pie 10, offers 1, and is accepted with probability 0.5; rejection pays zero. What is the proposer’s expected payoff?
